definition:
[N5] decide to do
Formation: Verb-plain + ことにする

examples: 毎日運動することにした。 I decided to exercise every day.
明日から禁煙することにします。 I will decide to quit smoking from tomorrow.

definition:
[N5] without doing
Formation: Verb-negative (ない) + ずに
Tags: negative, condition
examples: 朝ご飯を食べずに出かけた。 I went out without eating breakfast.

definition:
[N5] looks like; appears that
Formation: Verb-stem / i-adjective stem + そうだ
Tags: appearance
examples: このケーキはおいしそうだ。 This cake looks delicious.
雨が降りそうです。 It looks like it will rain.

definition:
[N5] intend to; plan to
Formation: Verb-plain + つもり
Tags: intention
examples: 来年、日本に留学するつもりだ。 I intend to study abroad in Japan next year.
今度の週末は何もするつもりはない。 I don't plan to do anything this weekend.

definition:
[N5] do something for someone (outward)
Formation: Verb-te + あげる
Tags: giving, favor
examples: 友達に本を貸してあげた。 I lent a book to my friend.
母に花を買ってあげます。 I will buy flowers for my mother.

definition:
[N5] go and do; do something and go away; continue
Formation: Verb-te + いく
Tags: direction, continuation
examples: 明日、荷物を持っていきます。 I will take the luggage with me tomorrow.
これからも頑張っていく。 I will keep doing my best from now on.

definition:
[N5] do something in advance; leave something in a state
Formation: Verb-te + おく
Tags: preparation
examples: 明日の朝のために水を出しておく。 I will put out water for tomorrow morning.
ドアを開けておいてください。 Please leave the door open.

definition:
[N5] come and do; do something and come back; start to
Formation: Verb-te + くる
Tags: direction, beginning
examples: すぐ戻ってきます。 I will come right back.
雨が降ってきた。 It started to rain.

definition:
[N5] someone does something for me
Formation: Verb-te + くれる
Tags: receiving, favor
examples: 先生が漢字を教えてくれた。 The teacher taught me kanji.
友達が傘を貸してくれた。 My friend lent me an umbrella.

definition:
[N5] do something completely; unintentionally; regret
Formation: Verb-te + しまう
Tags: completion, regret
examples: 財布を落としてしまった。 I dropped my wallet (by accident).
本を全部読んでしまった。 I ended up reading the whole book.

definition:
[N5] try doing something
Formation: Verb-te + みる
Tags: attempt
examples: 新しいレストランで食べてみる。 I will try eating at the new restaurant.
この靴を履いてみてもいいですか。 May I try on these shoes?

definition:
[N5] receive the favor of someone doing something
Formation: Verb-te + もらう
Tags: receiving, favor
examples: 田中さんに日本語を教えてもらう。 I receive Japanese lessons from Tanaka.
父に車を貸してもらった。 My father lent me his car.

definition:
[N5] must be; no doubt
Formation: Verb-plain / i-adjective / na-adjective + に違いない
Tags: certainty
examples: 彼は疲れているに違いない。 He must be tired.
この本は高いに違いない。 This book must be expensive.

definition:
[N5] certainly; must; no doubt
Formation: Verb-plain / i-adjective / na-adjective + に決まっている
Tags: certainty

definition:

definition:

definition:

definition:
[N5] too much; excessive

definition:

Formation: Verb-stem + 方

definition:

Formation: Verb-plain + ことだ

健康のために運動することだ。 You should exercise for your health.

definition:
[N4] there is no need to; never happens

definition:

Formation: Verb-plain + そうにする

元気そうに見せる。 I act as if I am healthy.

definition:
[N4] time; place; situation; about to
Formation: Verb-plain / Verb-te / Verb-ta + ところ

電話したところ、彼は出かけていた。 When I called, he had just gone out.

definition:

Tags: topic

definition:

definition:

Formation: Noun + によると

definition:
[N4] toward; in contrast to; regarding
Formation: Noun + に対して
Tags: target, contrast

兄は背が高いのに対して、弟は低い。 The older brother is tall, whereas the younger brother is short.

definition:
[N4] only; just; full of; tendency to
Formation: Verb-te / Noun + ばかり
Tags: limitation, habit
examples: 毎日ゲームをしているばかりだ。 I do nothing but play games every day.
彼は文句を言うばかりだ。 He does nothing but complain.

definition:
[N4] not only ... but also
Formation: Verb-plain / i-adjective / na-adjective + ばかりでなく
Tags: addition
examples: 彼女は頭がいいばかりでなく、優しい。 She is not only smart but also kind.
日本語を読むばかりでなく、書く練習もする。 I not only read Japanese but also practice writing.

definition:
[N4] it is natural/normal to; one should
Formation: Verb-plain + ものだ
Tags: general-truth, nostalgia
examples: 子供のころはよく遊んだものだ。 I used to play a lot as a child.
人は誰でも間違うものだ。 Everyone makes mistakes.

definition:
[N4] should not; it's not right to
Formation: Verb-plain + ものではない
Tags: prohibition, advice

嘘をつくものではない。 You shouldn't lie.

definition:
[N4] way/manner of; like; in order to
Formation: Verb-plain + よう
Tags: method, purpose
examples: 泳ぎ方を教えてください。 Please teach me how to swim.
分かるように説明する。 Explain so that it is understood.

definition:
[N4] make sure to; try to
Formation: Verb-plain + ようにする
Tags: effort, habit
examples: 毎日日本語を話すようにしている。 I make sure to speak Japanese every day.
早く寝るようにしてください。 Please try to go to bed early.

definition:
[N4] come to be able to; reach the point where
Formation: Verb-plain + ようになる
Tags: change, ability
examples: 毎日練習したら、泳げるようになった。 After practicing every day, I became able to swim.
日本に来てから、納豆が食べられるようになった。 Since coming to Japan, I became able to eat natto.

definition:
[N4] seems; I heard; typical (less casual than みたい)
Formation: Verb-plain / i-adjective / na-adjective + らしい
Tags: hearsay, appearance
examples: 彼は怒っているらしい。 He seems angry.
明日は台風が来るらしい。 I heard a typhoon is coming tomorrow.

definition:
[N4] there is no way that; impossible
Formation: Verb-plain / i-adjective / na-adjective + わけがない
Tags: impossibility, strong-negation

彼女が遅刻するわけがない。 There is no way she would be late.

definition:

Formation: Verb-plain / i-adjective / na-adjective + わけだ

彼は10年日本に住んでいる。日本語が上手なわけだ。 He has lived in Japan for 10 years. No wonder his Japanese is good.

definition:
[N4] it doesn't mean that; not necessarily
Formation: Verb-plain / i-adjective / na-adjective + わけではない
Tags: negation, nuance

definition:
[N4] on the one hand; on the other hand; while
Formation: Noun/Verb-plain + 一方
Tags: contrast

definition:
[N3] might; there is a risk that
Formation: Verb-stem + かねない
Tags: risk, possibility

definition:

Formation: Verb-plain / i-adjective / na-adjective + かのようだ
Tags: metaphor, appearance

definition:
[N3] cannot help but; can't resist
Formation: Verb-negative (ない) + ずにはいられない

彼の話を信じずにはいられなかった。 I couldn't help but believe his story.

definition:

Formation: Noun + にわたって
Tags: span, range

definition:
[N3] along; in line with; following
Formation: Noun + に沿って
Tags: direction, conformity

definition:
[N3] according to; in proportion to; depending on
Formation: Noun + に応じて
Tags: proportion, adaptation

収入に応じて支出を決める。 Decide expenses according to income.

definition:
[N3] in addition to
Formation: Noun + に加えて
Tags: addition
examples: 英語に加えて、フランス語も勉強している。 In addition to English, I also study French.
値上げに加えて、サービスも悪化した。 In addition to the price increase, service also deteriorated.

definition:
[N3] based on; in accordance with
Formation: Noun + に基づいて
Tags: basis
examples: データに基づいて判断する。 Judge based on data.
実際の経験に基づいて書いた。 I wrote it based on actual experience.

definition:
[N3] on the occasion of; at the time of
Formation: Noun + に際して
Tags: formal, timing
examples: 出発に際して、一言ご挨拶させていただきます。 On the occasion of our departure, please allow me to say a few words.
入社に際して、誓約書を提出した。 I submitted a pledge when joining the company.

definition:
[N3] when it comes to; at the point of
Formation: Noun + に至って
Tags: advanced-timing, formal
examples: 辞職に至った経緯を説明する。 Explain the circumstances that led to the resignation.
今回の事件に至って、ようやく問題の深刻さが分かった。 It was only with this incident that I finally understood the seriousness of the problem.

definition:
[N3] in place of; instead of; on behalf of
Formation: Noun + に代わって
Tags: substitution
examples: 社長に代わって挨拶する。 Give a speech on behalf of the president.
彼に代わって、私が出席した。 I attended in his place.

definition:
[N3] as; in accordance with; along with
Formation: Noun + に伴って
Tags: accompaniment
examples: 都市化に伴って、緑が減っている。 As urbanization progresses, greenery is decreasing.
人口の増加に伴って、問題も増えた。 Along with the increase in population, problems also increased.

definition:
[N3] contrary to; against
Formation: Noun + に反して
Tags: contrast
examples: 予想に反して、試験は簡単だった。 Contrary to expectations, the exam was easy.

definition:
[N3] triggered by; taking the opportunity of
Formation: Noun + をきっかけに
Tags: opportunity, trigger

definition:
[N3] concerning; regarding; around
Formation: Noun + をめぐって

遺産をめぐって争いが起きた。 A dispute arose over the inheritance.

definition:
[N3] cannot help feeling; unable to restrain
Formation: Noun + を禁じえない

彼の努力には感動を禁じえない。 I cannot help being moved by his efforts.

definition:

Formation: Noun + を除いて
Tags: exception

definition:

Formation: Noun + を通して
Tags: means, span

definition:

Formation: Noun + を通じて

definition:

definition:

definition:

Tags: abundance
examples: 彼女はいいことずくめだ。 She has nothing but good things going for her.
今日は黒ずくめの服装だ。 Today I'm dressed entirely in black.

definition:
[N1] even; not even (emphatic negative)
Formation: Noun + すら
Tags: emphasis, negative
examples: 彼は水すら飲まなかった。 He didn't even drink water.
子供すら知っている。 Even children know it.

definition:
[N1] even if; even though (unlikely to help)
Formation: Verb-ta + ところで
Tags: concessive, negative
examples: 今さら謝ったところで、許されないだろう。 Even if you apologize now, you probably won't be forgiven.
勉強したところで、間に合わない。 Even if I study, I won't make it in time.

definition:
[N1] full of; covered with; lots of (negative nuance)
Formation: Noun + だらけ
Tags: abundance, negative
examples: 部屋はゴミだらけだ。 The room is full of trash.
彼の言い訳は間違いだらけだ。 His excuses are full of mistakes.

definition:
[N1] once ... it's all over; the moment ...
Formation: Verb-ta + ら最後
Tags: irreversible, emphasis
examples: 彼に黙っていると言ったら最後、誰にも言うだろう。 Once you tell him to keep quiet, it's over — he'll tell everyone.
あの店に入ったら最後、何時間も出てこない。 Once she enters that shop, she won't come out for hours.

definition:
[N1] after all; in the end; as a result of
Formation: Verb-ta + 末（に/の）
Tags: result, process
examples: 長い議論の末、結論が出た。 After a long discussion, a conclusion was reached.
試行錯誤の末、成功した。 After trial and error, we succeeded.

definition:
[N1] ever since; from the time that
Formation: Verb-te + からというもの
Tags: since, change
examples: 日本に来てからというもの、毎日忙しい。 Ever since I came to Japan, I've been busy every day.
彼女に出会ってからというもの、人生が変わった。 Ever since I met her, my life has changed.

definition:
[N1] cannot stop doing; do nothing but
Formation: Verb-te + やまない
Tags: emotion, continuity
examples: 子供の将来を案じてやまない。 I can't stop worrying about my child's future.
彼の成功を願ってやまない。 I sincerely wish for his success.

definition:
[N1] when it comes to; now that
Formation: Verb-plain / Noun + ともなると
Tags: condition, emphasis
examples: 家族旅行ともなると、準備が大変だ。 When it comes to a family trip, the preparations are tough.
社長ともなると、責任が重い。 Once you become president, the responsibility is heavy.

definition:
[N1] combined with; together with
Formation: Noun + と相まって
Tags: combination, formal
examples: 好天に恵まれたことと相まって、大会は大成功だった。 Combined with the good weather, the event was a great success.
新技術の導入と相まって、生産性が向上した。 Together with the introduction of new technology, productivity improved.

definition:
[N1] unique to; only possible for; characteristic of
Formation: Noun + ならでは
Tags: uniqueness
examples: 京都ならではの風景だ。 This is a scenery unique to Kyoto.
プロならではの技術だ。 This is a technique only a professional can pull off.

definition:
[N1] in order to; for the purpose of (formal)
Formation: Verb-stem + べく
Tags: purpose, formal
examples: 成功を目指すべく、日夜努力している。 I strive day and night in order to achieve success.
問題を解決すべく、会議を開いた。 We held a meeting in order to solve the problem.

definition:
[N1] will not; let's not; probably not
Formation: Verb-stem + まい
Tags: negative-volition, prediction
examples: あんな失敗は二度とするまい。 I will never make such a mistake again.
彼は来るまい。 He probably won't come.

definition:
[N1] if one could; if only; if you think you can
Formation: Verb-potential + ものなら
Tags: hypothetical, challenge
examples: できるものなら、やってみろ。 If you think you can do it, go ahead and try.
戻れるものなら、戻りたい。 If only I could go back, I would.

definition:
[N1] depending on how; depending on the way
Formation: Verb-stem + ようによっては
Tags: condition, perspective
examples: 使いようによっては、この道具は便利だ。 Depending on how you use it, this tool is convenient.
考えようによっては、彼も正しい。 Depending on how you think about it, he is also right.
